name: clang_tidy
description: Lint C and C++ sources against the project's .clang-tidy

help: - Allow empty enabled checks
- Comma-separated list of globs with optional '-' prefix

- Specifies a configuration in YAML/JSON format: -config="{Checks: '*', CheckOptions: {x: y}}" When the value is empty, clang-tidy will attempt to find a file named .clang-tidy for each source file in its parent directories

- Specify the path of .clang-tidy or custom config file: e.g. --config-file=/some/path/myTidyConfigFile This option internally works exactly the same way as --config option after reading specified config file
- Dumps configuration in the YAML format to stdout
- Enable per-check timing profiles, and print a report to stderr
- Enables preprocessor-level module header parsing for C++20 and above, empowering specific checks to detect macro definitions within modules
headers to exclude diagnostics from
- For each enabled check explains, where it is enabled, i.e. in clang-tidy binary, command line or a specific configuration file
- YAML file to store suggested fixes in
- Additional argument to append to the compiler command line
- Additional argument to prepend to the compiler command line
- Apply suggested fixes
- Apply suggested fixes even if compilation errors were found
- If a warning has no fix, but a single fix can be found through an associated diagnostic note, apply the fix

- Style for formatting code around applied fixes: - 'none' (default) turns off formatting - 'file' (literally 'file', not a placeholder) uses .clang-format file in the closest parent directory - '{ <json> }' specifies options inline, e.g. -format-style='{BasedOnStyle: llvm, IndentWidth: 8}' - 'llvm', 'google', 'webkit', 'mozilla' See clang-format documentation for the up-to-date information about formatting styles and options
- Regular expression matching the names of the headers to output diagnostics from
- Display list of available options (--help-list-hidden for more)
- List of files with line ranges to filter the warnings
- List all enabled checks and exit
- Load the specified plugin
- Build path
- Run clang-tidy in quiet mode
- By default reports are printed in tabulated format to stderr
- Display the errors from system headers
- Use colors in diagnostics
- Check the config files to ensure each check and option is recognized
- Overlay the virtual filesystem described by file over the real file system
- Upgrades warnings to errors
